messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
 
Join our live online course Markov and Hidden Markov Models with Applications in R, taking place 1?4 September, and learn how to apply one of the most powerful modeling frameworks for longitudinal data.
 
 
Course website: [ https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/markov-and-hidden-markov-models-with-applications-in-r/ ]( https://www.physalia-courses.org/courses-workshops/markov-and-hidden-markov-models-with-applications-in-r/ ) 
 
 
Over four interactive sessions, you'll combine theory with hands-on practice using the LMest R package. You'll learn how to build, estimate, interpret, and select Markov and Hidden Markov Models for continuous, categorical, and incomplete longitudinal data.
 
Participants will:
Learn the fundamentals of Markov and Hidden Markov Models
Gain practical experience with R and the LMest package
Work through real data examples and interactive exercises
Discover best practices for model selection, interpretation, and reporting
 
Whether you're a researcher, graduate student, or data analyst working in academia, industry, or consultancy, this course will provide practical skills you can immediately apply to your own data.
 
 
Best regards,
 
Carlo
 
 

--------------------

Carlo Pecoraro, Ph.D
